When ordering comes from `Meta.ordering`, `get_order_by()` sets `self._meta_ordering` — but commit `0ddb4ebf7b` only used that flag later in `as_sql()` to drop the ORDER BY clause.         # Skip references to the SELECT clause, as all expressions in
        # the SELECT clause are already part of the GROUP BY.
        if not is_ref:
            expressions.extend(expr.get_group_by_cols())
